svg.aria-label: What was verified on 18 November 2026: 33 tests pass on DuckDB, including five days of all three pipelines with re-runs and out-of-order runs; the self-test passes 8 of 8 checks on PostgreSQL 16 and the five-day run passes there with no pipeline changed; 6 DAG tests pass in Airflow 3.4.0 and a full loans_daily run loaded 60 loans. Not run: Redshift, S3, GCS and Azure storage, the container files, and Airflow 2.
